name: shelfsense
description: Scan your skincare labels, catch clashes, doubles and gaps, and get a routine built from what you own.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.db:migrate: npm exec -w server -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: npm exec -w server -- prisma migrate deploy
